gameDescriptionHtml:
SPACEFLUX – THE ONE & ONLY FRACTAL FPS! In fractal space, the map contains itself. Going to the center takes you back to where you started. You can never reach the center!

RECURSIVE ARENA COMBAT – Learn to navigate the fractals in hyper-fast PvP combat. There are infinite copies of the map, with a copy of you on each map. Be careful, don’t shoot yourself in the back!! Your opponents have copies too. Shoot any copy to kill them.

MORE IMPOSSIBLE SPACES – Fractal space is just 1 of the 6 impossible spaces: Horizontal Loop – the map repeats infinitely in all directions; Minimap – a mini-version of the map exists within the map. Jump inside to land back onto the map; Mirror Mode – the map is reflected and so are you; Portals – enter a portal to another place in the map; Vertical Loop – fall forever!

HORDE MODE – The single player roguelike where you fight endless waves of heads in all impossible spaces. Can you beat Atomic Pete, or will he erase you from existence?

Game Features

  • 2-4 Player multiplayer deathmatches.
  • 10 Fully destructible and impossible maps.
  • Single-player survival horde mode.
  • Turn on ‘Psychedelic Mode’ to mess with your friends.
  • Abilities to flip gravity, spawn decoys or disguise yourself as a box.
  • Cosmetic gun skins for all 10 weapons.
  • Controller & Steam Deck support.
  • Peer-to-peer matchmaking.
